changes_made.explanation: Added the main proposed model 'PLATO' and baseline/comparison models (Seq2Seq, LIC, iVAE MI) that were evaluated. Removed generic 'Proposed model with latent variable' and replaced with specific model name 'PLATO'.
Normalized metric variants to base forms: Distinct-1/2 to 'Distinct', ROUGE-L to 'ROUGE'. Kept other metrics in their canonical forms.
Removed placeholder 'None' values as no LLM-based evaluation was used in this paper (published 2020, before widespread LLM-as-judge practices).

guideline: Responses scored on 0-2 scale for fluency, coherence, informativeness, and overall quality by three crowdworkers using majority voting

changes_made.explanation: Created consolidated guideline description from multiple text excerpts. Normalized criteria to title case. Added clarity that scoring was on 0-2 scale with three annotators using majority voting.

overall_notes: The paper presents a dialogue generation model (PLATO) with discrete latent variables. Extracted metadata was generally accurate but needed normalization of metric variants and addition of the main proposed model name. The paper uses both automatic metrics (BLEU, Distinct, etc.) and human evaluation with clear criteria. No LLM-based evaluation was used (paper from 2020).
